reading.body:
Strategic Datasphere is listed at a real office address in Alpharetta, Georgia, in a technology corridor where data center and network infrastructure operators do exist. The facility has no confirmed operator, no working company website, no published specifications, and no independent record of any business operating under this name. Research has been exhausted without locating evidence that Strategic Datasphere is currently operating as a data center company.

Georgia has four data centers with published power specifications totaling 66.3 megawatts. This facility cannot be ranked among them because it publishes no power figure and its operational status remains unconfirmed. Thirty-three facilities are mapped in the state through OpenStreetMap, most of which publish no capacity data.

Without an operator website, published specifications, or third-party verification, this campus does not yet belong in analysis of AI infrastructure scaling or grid constraints. It should remain tagged as an unconfirmed listing pending evidence of current operation.
